title: Milestone 2 — wait only after a retry is admitted
subtitle: Acceptance case: four reads, three temporary failures, and requested waits of 0.1, 0.2, 0.25 seconds. Waiting is a separate dependency from the operation.

actors.title: Report viewer
body: Proposed: adds delay choices and receives the report after four reads.

actors.title: RetryPolicy
body: Proposed: also validate initial_delay=0.1 and max_delay=0.25.

actors.title: retry executor
body: Proposed: retain admission checks, consume a fresh interval iterator, and wait only between calls.

actors.title: load_report
body: Proposed: succeeds on read 4 after three failures. Readiness remains caller-owned.

actors.title: wait(seconds)
body: time.sleep in production; recording function in tests. It can block longer than requested or fail.

events: returns the same report; no further wait
notes: If read 4 fails: re-raise failure #4 with the same three waits. There is no fourth wait.
If waiting fails: propagate the waiting failure; do not classify it as a callback failure.
The iterator computes intervals inside the executor; the waiting provider owns the blocking mechanism.
